name: garmin-coach
description: Let Claude read your Garmin activities: runs, rides, swims, laps, heart rate, running dynamics, weekly trends.
long_description:
Garmin Coach keeps a private archive of your Garmin Connect activities on your computer (original FIT files, laps and second-by-second data) and lets Claude analyse them: single runs or rides, intervals, cardiac drift, weekly volume and intensity, long-term trends. Works with every sport recorded on Garmin.

Data is read through Garmin's official Connect Personal API, which is read-only: this extension never writes anything to your Garmin account. You only need a Personal API key, created in Garmin Connect under Settings → Personal API.

It can also read your weight and body composition (Garmin scale) and daily totals such as calories, steps and resting heart rate.

Your data stays on your computer, in the folder you choose.

garmin_api_key.title: Garmin Personal API key
garmin_api_key.description: Required. Lets Garmin Coach read (never change) your Garmin data. Create it in Garmin Connect on the web: Settings → Personal API (connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken).

data_folder.title: Data folder
data_folder.description: Where your archive (activities, notes, heart-rate zones) is saved. A 'Garmin Coach' folder is created inside the folder you pick. Default: Documents.

backfill_from.title: Import runs from (YYYY-MM-DD)
backfill_from.description: Used only for the first import: activities from this date on are downloaded (YYYY-MM-DD). An older date makes the first import longer. Older activities can be added later by asking Claude.

hr_bands.title: Starting heart-rate zones (optional)
hr_bands.description: The bpm where zones 2, 3, 4 and 5 begin, comma separated (e.g. 135,150,160,170 = Z1 below 135 … Z5 from 170). Copy them from Garmin Connect (Heart rate zones). After a new test, just tell Claude your new zones in chat.
